Odin's custom serialization protocol is stable and fast. It is built to be fast, reliable and resilient above all.

However, caveats apply - there is a reason Unity chose such a drastically limited serialization protocol. It keeps things simple and manageable, and limits how much complexity you can introduce into your data structures. It can be very easy to get carried away and shoot yourself in the foot when all limitations suddenly disappear, and hence we have included this cautionary warning.

Warning words aside, there can of course be valid reasons to use a more powerful serialization protocol such as Odin's. However, we advise you to use it wisely and with restraint. After all, with great power comes great responsibility!

In 2018.3, Unity introduced a new prefab workflow, and in so doing, changed how all prefabs fundamentally work. Despite our best efforts, we have so far been unable to achieve a stable implementation of Odin-serialized prefab modifications on prefab instances and variants in the new prefab workflow.This has nothing to do with Odin serializer itself, which remains rock solid. Odin-serialized ScriptableObjects and non-prefab Components/Behaviours are still perfectly stable - you are only seeing this message because this is an Odin-serialized prefab asset or instance.

Using prefabs with Odin serialization in 2018.3 and above is considered a *deprecated feature* and is officially unsupported. In short, if you disregard this message and then experience issues, we will not be able to help or support you.

The game houses both ads and in-app purchases. We process certain information including personal data when providing, maintaining and developing the Application.

This privacy policy may be updated from time to time. We will notify you of any changes to our privacy policy by posting the new privacy policy here and informing you via Google, Discord (if you are a Discord user) or the In-Game News panel. You are advised to consult this privacy policy regularly for any changes, as continued use is deemed approval of all changes.

matches.value: The Ixion-Infused Tiberius Mining Pack, which is situated at the back of mining personnel and/or connected to auto-miner power intakes, was initially created to enhance the efficiency of auto-mining devices in extracting valuable minerals from celestial bodies.

entry_context.value: Ah, this is a funny one that harkens back to my earlier self.

You see, eons ago when I engaged in teaching endeavors, one perennial challenge I encountered was maintaining the focus of my apprentices. Thus, I devised this remarkable trinket, the Wireless Brain Wave Stimulator.
Placing it in proximity to your Koios Scientist team promises to greatly enhance their concentration and productivity.
Why don't you give it a try, Synthetic?

The Ixion-Infused Tiberius Mining Pack, which is situated at the back of mining personnel and/or connected to auto-miner power intakes, was initially created to enhance the efficiency of auto-mining devices in extracting valuable minerals from celestial bodies.

By seamlessly integrating this advanced technology into your Mining Equipment, you will undoubtedly experience a  surge in mineral extraction success. This trinket promises to help min-max your shard collection.
Originally distributed among field teams for coordination during recon and salvage operations, the PDTA became a staple for engineers.
While older models are basic signal repeaters, later versions gained firmware injection capabilities
leading to controlled use in command overrides and system recovery protocols.
The Lupus Looping Anti-Blockade Device, a venerable creation cherished by countless iterations of... you!
This device serves as a steadfast safeguard for your Zagreus Loop Engine, ensuring it doesn't succumb to overheating quite so swiftly.

As its name suggests, it harnesses cosmic principles to regulate and dissipate excess heat, prolonging the operational lifespan of your engine. Thousands have entrusted their engines to its care; it's your turn to benefit from its cosmic craftsmanship and extend your journeys across the cosmos.
The Lost Last Manufacturer's handbook is the last handbook from the original manufacturers to have ever been produced. Seemingly, it isn't lost anymore...

entry_context.value: Borge reflects on his own weaknesses. Although he isn't the brightest, he managed to find out how to reduce the damage he takes from enemy Critical Strikes.
Never run out of Gun-powder. Or extra bullets. Knox gains a chance to add 3 additional projectiles to his Salvo.
Ozzy likes Living off the Land. Somehow that increases his Max HP and HP Regen. Don't overthink it. It's good.

Superior Sensors lets Borge perform more evades as well as proc more effects. Now that's useful tech!

Blessing of the Scarab provides a unique Damage Reduction multiplier and an additive increase to all Ozzy Loot gained.
Helltouch Barrier reflects damage that Borge takes right back at the attacker! Calculated after DMG Reduction.
